title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 5
body: He disappears when it gets serious and comes back when you stop waiting. He says "sorry, I was busy" and was online fourteen times. Two weeks of daily texts, ten days of silence, then "hey stranger." He is not busy. He is keeping his options open, and you are one of the options.
caption:
Send this to the friend who defends him.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 5
body: Her birthday is a month, not a day. A week of dinners, a week of gifts, a week of "you forgot." She says "I don't expect anything" and has a wishlist link ready. "I'm not materialistic" while describing the exact watch, the exact colour and the exact shop.
caption:
Tag the friend who says it's fine.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 5
body: "What do you think about joint family?" They ask like it is a pop quiz with a mark scheme. There is no right answer. If you say yes, you are "too traditional." If you say no, you are "too modern." They decided before the chai came. Enjoy the samosas.
caption:
Send this to someone with a rishta meeting this week.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 5
body: "I'm busy these days." She had time for her cousin's birthday, the match, a trip to Murree and nine stories. Nobody is too busy for a person they want. You are not in her busy season. You are in her backup folder, between the dentist and the gym.
caption:
Send this to the friend still waiting for a reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 5
body: He parks where you can see the car. He tells you the model, the year, the price and the cousin who got a better deal. The engine gets more compliments than you do. He says "I'm very simple" while describing a car that cost more than your father's house.
caption:
Which one happened to you? Be honest.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 5
body: Good morning every day for ten days. Then silence for six. Then "what's up stranger." You are not a stranger. You are a backup. He comes back whenever the other options go quiet. Do not reply on the first message. Make him use the second.
caption:
Screenshot this and send it to your group chat.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 5
body: The moment she is dating someone, you disappear from her chat. The moment they break up, "hey, are you free?" You are a seasonal service. Eid special, break up special, exam stress special. She is not a bad person. She is just comfortable with a free helpline.
caption:
Tag the friend who is everyone's free therapist.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 5
body: He is private with you and public with everyone else. Likes every girl's photo and comments "queen" on thirty accounts. When one word is used thirty times, it is not a compliment, it is a stock phrase. Ask for a comment that is not a copy paste.
caption:
Tag the friend who needs this before the weekend.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 5
body: He is the first viewer on every story you post. Every single one. In the morning, at night, from the toilet. He says "I'm busy" but he has seen your story before your mother has. He is not busy. He is a full time viewer who is allergic to texting.
caption:
Check his tagged photos before you reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 5
body: The light comes on for other girls. He proposed to the girl he met three months after you. You were not wrong. You were early. Early feels the same as wrong, but it is not your fault. A taxi cannot pick you up if the driver is not on shift.
caption:
Tag the friend whose ex got engaged in two months.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 5
body: The first meeting: "we are open minded." Second meeting: "but she should wear a dupatta." Third: "and cover her head." Fourth: "and maybe not work." It is a rishta with a software update every week, and none of the updates were asked for.
caption:
Tag someone whose rishta is stuck in committee.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 5
body: He told you that you are his twin flame, the third time this year. Previous twin flames: Zainab, Hira and one in Dubai. The universe keeps sending him twins. Either it has a printing error or he does. Ask for a refund, or at least a name tag.
caption:
Tag the friend who asked your moon sign on the first date.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 5
body: "Open minded, but traditional." That is an error in the code. In practice: she can work, as long as she does not leave the house. She can have opinions, as long as they match. Open minded is a quality they praise, and traditional is a rule they enforce.
caption:
Send this to a girl who has read a rishta profile.
